_note: Shipped governance defaults: the nine gates and three rule sets. Simplified demo encodings, not legal advice. Admin-added gates live in the hash-chained gate log, never in this file.

approved_infrastructure.label: Model calls and data stay on approved (DESC-certified) infrastructure
approved_infrastructure.kbQuery: hosting certified cloud infrastructure data location security requirements

audit_log.label: Every action is written to the audit log
audit_log.kbQuery: logging audit trail traceability records of agent actions monitoring

data_lawful.label: Data is lawfully usable for this purpose
data_lawful.kbQuery: personal data protection lawful processing consent privacy purpose limitation

human_final_approval.label: A person gives final approval before any output reaches a citizen
human_final_approval.kbQuery: human oversight review approve override before action human in the loop

ai_disclosure.label: The citizen is told they are dealing with an AI assistant
ai_disclosure.kbQuery: inform users they are interacting with AI transparency disclosure

hallucination_rate.label: Measured hallucination rate stays under the agreed threshold
hallucination_rate.kbQuery: accuracy reliability monitoring transparency inform users interacting with AI

fee_accuracy.label: Fees and amounts quoted to citizens match the published fee table
fee_accuracy.kbQuery: accuracy of information given to citizens fees transparency reliability monitoring

no_commercial_promotion.label: The assistant does not promote paid third-party products to citizens
no_commercial_promotion.kbQuery: AI systems should be fair transparent accountable understandable consumer commercial promotion

purpose_limitation.label: Data is used only for its declared purpose, with no inferred sensitive attributes
purpose_limitation.kbQuery: collected for a specific and clear purpose, not processed at any later time in a manner incompatible with such purpose
